observations: Photo 0 shows a cream-colored sewing machine on a dark wooden stand, with visible rust and paint chipping, especially on the left spool pin and base.
Two metal parts (possibly bobbin case and bobbin) are placed on the stand in front of the machine.
Photo 1 and 2 are nearly identical, showing the front of the machine with a blue control panel labeled 'ZIG-ZAG 012345 WIDTH' and a logo with the word 'BUTTERFLY' below it.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a presser foot, and a needle assembly.
The stand appears to be made of wood with metal legs, showing wear and scuff marks.
The machine is not shown in operation; no power cord or plug is visible.
The photos are watermarked 'POSTED ON JIJI GEREY CHUKWU'.

claims.claim: Fairly used original butterfly Sewing Machine and stand
claims.evidence: Photos show a Butterfly sewing machine with visible wear and tear consistent with 'fairly used'. The stand is included and visible in all photos.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may require repair
risks.proof: Video or photo of the machine operating, including needle movement, presser foot lifting, and stitch formation.

risks.risk: Missing parts or accessories (e.g., power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out, including power cord and foot pedal.

risks.risk: Internal rust or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the interior of the machine, especially around the bobbin case and shuttle area.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine operating with a test stitch.
Photo showing the power cord and foot pedal (if included).
Photo showing the interior of the machine, especially the bobbin area.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a Butterfly ZIG-ZAG 012345 WIDTH model, and the claim of 'fairly used' is supported by visible wear. However, functionality and completeness cannot be confirmed from the photos alone, which are critical for pricing. The machine must be proven to work and include all necessary accessories before a price can be assigned.
